place.name: National Archives of Belgium
place.description: The National Archives of Belgium (Dutch: Algemeen Rijksarchief; French: Archives générales du Royaume; German: Generalstaatsarchiv; all lit. 'General Archives of the Kingdom') is the main depository of the State Archives of Belgium (Archives de l'État; Rijksarchief). It is located on the Rue de Ruysbroeck/Ruysbroeckstraat, next to the Mont des Arts/Kunstberg, in central Brussels.
